pub fn validate_config_value(v: &Value) -> ::std::result::Result<(),Refusal> { if !((v.kind.as_str() == "unlimited" || v.kind.as_str() == "boolean" || v.kind.as_str() == "integer" || v.kind.as_str() == "bytes" || v.kind.as_str() == "duration" || v.kind.as_str() == "text" || v.kind.as_str() == "choice" || v.kind.as_str() == "text_list" || v.kind.as_str() == "text_map") && (v.kind.as_str() == "boolean" || !v.boolean) && (v.kind.as_str() == "integer" || v.integer == 0) && (v.kind.as_str() == "bytes" || v.bytes == 0) && (v.kind.as_str() == "duration" || v.duration_ms == 0) && (v.kind.as_str() == "text" || v.text.is_empty()) && (v.kind.as_str() == "choice" || v.choice.is_empty()) && (v.kind.as_str() == "text_list" || v.text_list.is_empty()) && (v.kind.as_str() == "text_map" || v.text_map.is_empty())) { return Err(Refusal{word:"bad_value",offset:0}); }
